q.ml: തീപോലെ ജ്വലിക്കുമോ എന്നു സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നത് എന്ത്?

q.en: Upon whom does the psalmist ask God to pour out His wrath?
q.ta: தேவனுடைய உக்கிரத்தை யார்மேல் ஊற்றும்படி சங்கீதக்காரன் கேட்கிறான்?
q.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ ക്രോധം ആരുടെമേൽ പകരണമെന്നു സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ പറയുന്നു?

a.en: The heathen that have not known Him

q.en: Whom have they devoured?
What does the psalmist ask God not to remember against us?
q.ta: எவற்றை எங்களுக்கு விரோதமாக நினைக்கவேண்டாம் என்று கேட்கிறான்?

q.en: For the glory of what does the psalmist ask God to help?
q.ta: எதன் மகிமையினிமித்தம் தேவன் உதவி செய்யவேண்டும் என்று கேட்கிறான்?

q.en: What does the psalmist ask God to purge away?
What do the heathen say?
What does the psalmist ask to come before God?
q.ta: தேவனுக்கு முன்பாக வரட்டும் என்று கேட்பது எது?
q.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ മുമ്പാകെ വരട്ടെ എന്നു പറയുന്നത് എന്ത്?

q.en: How many times over should God render their reproach into their neighbours' bosom?
q.ta: அயலாரின் நிந்தையை தேவன் எத்தனை மடங்காகத் திரும்பப்பண்ணவேண்டும்?
q.ml: അയൽക്കാരുടെ നിന്ദ ദൈവം എത്ര ഇരട്ടിയായി പകരം കൊടുക്കണം?

q.en: What are we called, who will give God thanks for ever?
q.ta: என்றென்றைக்கும் தேவனைப் புகழுவோம் என்பவர்கள் தங்களை எவ்வாறு அழைக்கிறார்கள்?
q.ml: എന്നേക്കും ദൈവത്തിനു സ്തോത്രം ചെയ്യുന്ന നാം ആരാകുന്നു?

a.en: His people and sheep of His pasture

q.en: Whom does the psalmist call upon as the Shepherd of Israel?
q.ta: இஸ்ரவேலின் மேய்ப்பரே என்று சங்கீதக்காரன் யாரை அழைக்கிறான்?
q.ml: യിസ്രായേലിന്റെ ഇടയനേ എന്നു സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ആരെ വിളിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Whom does the Shepherd of Israel lead like a flock?
Between whom does God dwell in Psalm 80?
Which three tribes are named in Psalm 80:2?
What does the psalmist ask God to cause to shine?
q.ta: தேவன் எதைப் பிரகாசிக்கப்பண்ண வேண்டும் என்று கேட்கிறான்?

q.en: What shall happen if God turns us again and His face shines?
q.ta: தேவன் திருப்பி முகத்தைப் பிரகாசிக்கப்பண்ணினால் என்ன நடக்கும்?

q.en: Against what is God angry, according to Psalm 80:4?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനം 80:4 പ്രകാരം ദൈവം എന്തിനു നേരെ കോപിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: With what has God fed them?
What does God make us unto our neighbours?
What did God bring out of Egypt?
Whom did God cast out to plant the vine?
What did the vine do in the land?

a.en: Took deep root and filled it

q.en: What were the hills covered with?
To what were its boughs like?
Unto what did the vine send out her boughs?
Unto what did the vine send out her branches?
What has God broken down so that all who pass by pluck the vine?
What out of the wood doth waste the vine?
From where does the psalmist ask God to look down?
q.ta: தேவன் எங்கிருந்து கண்ணோக்கிப் பார்க்கவேண்டும் என்று கேட்கிறான்?

q.en: With what is the vine burned and cut down?
Upon whom does the psalmist ask God's hand to be?
q.ta: தேவனுடைய கரம் யார்மீது இருக்கவேண்டும் என்று கேட்கிறான்?

a.en: The man of His right hand

q.en: What will the people do if God quickens them?
Which name of God is used in Psalm 80:19, the God of what?
Unto whom did the psalmist say to sing aloud?
To the God of whom should we make a joyful noise?
Which instrument is told to be brought for the psalm, along with the harp?
q.ta: சங்கீதம் பாட வீணையுடன் எந்தக் கருவியை வாசிக்கச் சொன்னான்?
q.ml: സംഗീതത്തിന്നു കിന്നരത്തോടൊപ്പം ഏതു വാദ്യം എടുക്കുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Which instrument are we told to blow at the new moon?
When are we told to blow the trumpet?
What was the feast a statute for?
Whose law is the feast said to be?
In whom did God ordain this for a testimony?
Out of which land did Israel go when God ordained this testimony?
q.ml: ഏതു ദേശത്തിന്റെ നേരെ പുറപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ ദൈവം ഇതു നിയമിച്ചു?

q.en: From what did God remove Israel's shoulder?
q.ml: ഞാൻ അവന്റെ തോളിൽനിന്നു എന്തു നീക്കി എന്നു ദൈവം പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: From what were Israel's hands delivered?
When did Israel call, and God delivered them?
q.ml: എപ്പോൾ നീ വിളിച്ചു, ഞാൻ നിന്നെ വിടുവിച്ചു എന്നു ദൈവം പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Where did God answer Israel?

a.en: In the secret place of thunder

q.en: At which waters did God prove Israel?
What did God say He will do unto His people?
q.ta: தேவன் தம் ஜனத்துக்கு என்ன செய்வேன் என்றார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ ജനത്തോടു എന്തു ചെയ്യും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What kind of god shall not be in Israel?
Who brought Israel out of the land of Egypt?
What does God say He will do when Israel opens the mouth wide?
q.ta: வாயை விரிவாய்த் திறந்தால் தேவன் என்ன செய்வார்?
q.ml: വായ് വിസ്താരത്തിൽ തുറന്നാൽ ദൈവം എന്തു ചെയ്യും?

q.en: Who would not hearken to God's voice?
Who would none of God?
Unto what did God give Israel up?
In whose ways does God wish Israel had walked?
What would God soon have subdued if Israel had obeyed?
q.ta: இஸ்ரவேல் கீழ்ப்படிந்திருந்தால் தேவன் சீக்கிரத்தில் எதைத் தாழ்த்தியிருப்பார்?
q.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ അനുസരിച്ചിരുന്നെങ്കിൽ ദൈവം വേഗത്തിൽ എന്തു കീഴടക്കുമായിരുന്നു?

q.en: Who should have submitted themselves unto the LORD?
With what would God have fed them?
With what out of the rock would God have satisfied them?
Where does God stand?

a.en: In the congregation of the mighty

q.en: Among whom does God judge?
How does God rebuke those who judge?
Whose persons were they accepting?
Whom are we told to defend?
To whom are we told to do justice?
Out of whose hand should the poor and needy be rid?
In what do the unknowing ones walk?
What are out of course?

a.en: All the foundations of the earth

q.en: What did God say to them: "Ye are ..."?
Whose children did God say they all are?
q.ta: அவர்கள் யாருடைய மக்கள் என்று தேவன் சொன்னார்?
q.ml: നിങ്ങൾ ആരുടെ പുത്രന്മാർ എന്നു ദൈവം പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: How shall they die?
What does the psalmist ask God to arise and judge?
What shall God inherit?
What does the psalmist ask God not to keep?
What do God's enemies make?
Against whom have they taken crafty counsel?
Whose name did the enemies want to be no more in remembrance?
q.ta: யாருடைய பேர் இனி நினைக்கப்படாமல் போகவேண்டும் என்றார்கள்?
q.ml: ആരുടെ പേർ ഇനി ആരും ഓർക്കരുതു എന്നു അവർ പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: How did the enemies consult together?
The tabernacles of which people are first named among the confederates?
Which people descended from Ishmael joined the confederacy?
Which people of Moab are named with Edom and the Ishmaelites?
Which two peoples are named with Gebal?
With whom were the Philistines joined?
Which nation also joined the confederacy?
Whom did Assur help?
Like which people does the psalmist ask God to deal with the enemies?
q.ta: எந்த ஜனத்துக்குச் செய்ததுபோல் செய்யவேண்டும் என்று கேட்கிறான்?
q.ml: ഏതു ജാതിയോടു ചെയ്തതുപോലെ ചെയ്യേണമേ എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: At which brook were Sisera and Jabin dealt with?
Where did Sisera and Jabin perish?
What did they become for the earth?
Which two nobles are named with Zebah and Zalmunna?
q.ta: சேபாவுக்கும் சல்முனாவுக்கும் முன் குறிப்பிடப்பட்ட பிரபுக்கள் யார்?
q.ml: സേബഹിനോടും സല്മൂന്നായോടും കൂടെ പറഞ്ഞ കുലീനന്മാർ ആർ?

q.en: Which two princes are named after Oreb and Zeeb?
q.ta: ஓரேப், சேபுக்குப் பின் குறிப்பிடப்பட்ட பிரபுக்கள் யார்?
q.ml: ഓരേബ്, സേബ് എന്നിവരോടു കൂടെ പറഞ്ഞ പ്രഭുക്കന്മാർ ആർ?

q.en: What did the enemies say they would take for possession?
q.ml: അവർ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ എന്തു അവകാശമാക്കും എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Like what before the wind does the psalmist ask God to make them?
What does fire burn like in the psalmist's prayer?
What does the flame set on fire?
With what does the psalmist ask God to persecute the enemies?
Why are the enemies' faces filled with shame?

a.en: That they may seek thy name

q.en: What are the enemies asked to be, for ever?
What is God's name alone?
Over what is God the most high?
Whose tabernacles does the psalmist call amiable?
What does the psalmist's soul long and faint for?
Unto what God do his heart and flesh cry out?
q.ta: அவன் இருதயமும் மாம்சமும் எந்த தேவனை நோக்கிக் கெம்பீரிக்கிறது?
q.ml: അവന്റെ ഹൃദയവും മാംസവും ഏതു ദൈവത്തെ നോക്കി ഘോഷിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Which bird found a house near God's altars?
q.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ യാഗപീഠങ്ങളുടെ അടുക്കൽ വീടു കണ്ടെത്തിയ പക്ഷി ഏത്?

q.en: Which bird found a nest to lay her young?
q.ta: குஞ്சுகளை வைக்கும் கூடு கிடைத்த பறவை எது?

q.en: Whom does the psalmist call his King and his God?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தன் ராஜாவும் தேவனுமாக யாரை அழைக்கிறான்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ തന്റെ രാജാവും ദൈവവുമായി ആരെ വിളിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Who are blessed?

a.en: They that dwell in thy house

q.en: What will they be still doing in God's house?
Which man is blessed?

a.en: The man whose strength is in God

q.en: Through which valley do they pass?
What do they make of the valley of Baca?
How do they go on their way?
In which place does every one of them appear before God?
Of which patriarch is God called the God in the psalmist's prayer?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் ஜெபத்தில் தேவன் யாருடைய தேவன் என்று அழைக்கப்படுகிறார்?
q.ml: പ്രാർത്ഥനയിൽ ദൈവത്തെ ആരുടെ ദൈവം എന്നു വിളിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What is God called in verse nine?
Whose face does the psalmist ask God to look upon?
What is better than a thousand days?
What would the psalmist rather be in the house of his God?
Where would he not dwell?
What two things is the LORD God?
What two things will the LORD give?
To whom will God not withhold any good thing?
Who is blessed, as the psalm closes?

a.en: The man that trusteth in the LORD

q.en: Whose captivity did the LORD bring back?
Toward what did the LORD show favour?
What did God forgive?
What has God covered?
What has God taken away?
What does the psalmist call God in his prayer to turn us?
For how long does the psalmist ask if God will be angry?
Why does the psalmist ask God to revive us?

a.en: That thy people may rejoice in thee

q.en: What does the psalmist ask God to show us?
What does he ask God to grant us?
What will God speak unto his people?
Unto what should they not turn again?
To whom is God's salvation nigh?
What may dwell in our land?
What two things are met together?
What two things have kissed each other?
What shall spring out of the earth?
What shall look down from heaven?
What shall our land yield?
What shall go before the LORD?
Whom does the psalmist call himself before the LORD?
What does the psalmist ask God to preserve?
Who is the servant that trusteth in God?
How often does the psalmist cry unto God?
What does he lift up unto the Lord?
What three things is the Lord said to be to those who call upon him?

a.en: Good, ready to forgive, plenteous in mercy

q.en: What does the psalmist ask God to attend to?
When will the psalmist call upon God?

a.en: In the day of his trouble

q.en: Among the gods, who is like unto the Lord?
Who shall come and worship before the Lord?
What two things is God, who alone is God?
Who alone is God?
What does the psalmist ask God to teach him?
q.ta: தேவன் தனக்கு எதைப் போதிக்கவேண்டும் என்று கேட்கிறான்?
q.ml: ദൈവം തനിക്കു എന്തു കാണിച്ചുതരേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What does he ask God to unite?
With how much of his heart will he praise the Lord?
Who have risen against the psalmist?
What have the assemblies of violent men sought after?
What kind of God is the Lord?
Whose son does the psalmist call himself?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ താൻ ആരുടെ പുത്രൻ എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: What does he ask God to give unto his servant?
What does the psalmist ask God to show him?
q.ta: தேவன் தனக்கு எதைக் காண்பிக்கவேண்டும் என்று கேட்கிறான்?
q.ml: ദൈവം തനിക്കു എന്തു തരേണം എന്നു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Why does he ask for a token?
Where is the LORD's foundation?
Which gates does the LORD love?
More than all the dwellings of whom does the LORD love Zion?
What is Zion called in this psalm?
What are spoken of the city of God?
Which two cities does the LORD mention, Rahab and what other?
Which country is named along with Philistia and Tyre?
q.ml: ഫെലിസ്ത്യ, സോർ എന്നിവയോടു കൂടെ പറഞ്ഞ ദേശം ഏത്?

q.en: Who shall establish Zion?
What will the LORD do when he writeth up the people?
Who shall be there, saying all my springs are in thee?
q.ta: எங்கள் ஊற்றுகளெல்லாம் உன்னில் என்று சொல்லுவோர் யார்?
q.ml: എന്റെ ഉറവുകൾ ഒക്കെയും നിന്നിൽ എന്നു പറയുന്നവർ ആർ?

a.en: The singers and the players on instruments

q.en: Whom does the psalmist call the God of his salvation?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தன் இரட்சிப்பின் தேவன் என்று யாரை அழைக்கிறான்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ തന്റെ രക്ഷയുടെ ദൈവം എന്നു ആരെ വിളിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: When has the psalmist cried before God?
What does he ask God to incline unto his cry?
With what is his soul full?
Unto what does his life draw nigh?
With whom is he counted?

a.en: Them that go down into the pit

q.en: Like whom does he lie in the grave?
q.ta: அவன் பிரேதக்குழிகளிலே கிடக்கிறவர்களைப் போல யாரைப்போல் ஆனான்?

q.en: Where has God laid him?
What lieth hard upon him?
With what has God afflicted him?
What has God put far from him?
What can he not do because he is shut up?
What mourns by reason of affliction?
What has he stretched out unto God?
To whom does the psalmist ask if God will show wonders?
q.ta: தேவன் யாருக்கு அதிசயங்களைச் செய்வீரோ என்று கேட்கிறான்?
q.ml: ദൈവം ആർക്കു അത്ഭുതങ്ങൾ കാണിക്കുമോ എന്നു ചോദിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Where might God's lovingkindness be declared, he asks?
q.ta: உமது கிருபை எங்கே விவரிக்கப்படுமோ என்று கேட்கிறான்?
q.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദയ എവിടെ വർണ്ണിക്കപ്പെടുമോ എന്നു ചോദിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What might be known in the land of forgetfulness?
When shall his prayer come before God?
q.ta: அவன் விண்ணப்பம் எப்பொழுது தேவனுக்கு முன்பாக வரும்?

q.en: What two things does the psalmist ask why God does to him?
q.ta: தேவன் ஏன் என்ன செய்கிறார் என்று கேட்கிறான்?

a.en: Casts off his soul and hides his face

q.en: Since when has he been afflicted and ready to die?
What have cut him off?
Like what did they come round about him daily?
What two persons has God put far from him?
What will the psalmist sing of for ever?
What will he make known to all generations with his mouth?
q.ta: அவன் தன் வாயினால் தலைமுறை தலைமுறையாக எதை அறிவிப்பான்?

q.en: What shall be built up for ever?
Where does God establish his faithfulness?
Unto whom did God swear, calling him his servant?
q.ta: தேவன் தம் தாசன் என்று யாரிடம் ஆணையிட்டார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ ദാസൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു ആരോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തു?

q.en: What will God establish for ever?
What will God build up to all generations?
What shall the heavens praise?
Where shall God's faithfulness be praised?

a.en: In the congregation of the saints

q.en: Who in heaven can be compared unto the LORD?
Where is God greatly to be feared?

a.en: In the assembly of the saints

q.en: Who is a strong LORD like unto God?
What is round about the LORD?
What does God rule?
What does God still when they arise?
Whom did God break in pieces as one slain?
With what did God scatter his enemies?
To whom do the heavens and the earth belong?
Which two mountains rejoice in God's name?
q.ta: எந்த இரண்டு மலைகள் தேவனுடைய நாமத்தில் கெம்பீரிக்கும்?
q.ml: ഏതു രണ്ടു പർവ്വതങ്ങൾ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ നാമത്തിൽ ആനന്ദിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What two directions did God create?
What does God have that is mighty?
What are the habitation of God's throne?
What two things go before God's face?
Which people are blessed?

a.en: They that know the joyful sound

q.en: In what light shall they walk?
In what shall they rejoice all the day?
By what shall they be exalted?
What is the glory of their strength?
What shall be exalted in God's favour?
Who is our defence?
Who is our king?
In what did God speak to his holy one?
Whom did God find?
With what did God anoint David?
What shall strengthen David?
Who shall not exact upon David?
What will God do to David's foes before his face?
What shall be with David?
Where will God set David's hand?
Where will his right hand be set?
What will David call God?
What will David call God regarding his salvation?
q.ml: രക്ഷയെക്കുറിച്ചു ദാവീദ് ദൈവത്തെ എന്തു എന്നു വിളിക്കും?

q.en: What will God make David?
Higher than whom will David be?
For how long will God keep his mercy for David?
q.ta: தேவன் எவ்வளவு காலம் தம் கிருபையை அவனுக்காகக் காப்பார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം എത്രകാലം തന്റെ ദയ അവന്നു കാണിക്കും?

q.en: His throne shall be as long as what?
What if David's children forsake God's law?
q.ta: தாவீதின் பிள்ளைகள் தேவனுடைய வேதத்தை விட்டால் என்ன?

a.en: They would not walk in his judgments

q.en: With what will God visit their transgression?
With what will God visit their iniquity?
What will God not utterly take from David?
What will God not break?
By what did God swear once?
To whom will God not lie?
Like what shall David's throne be before God?
Like what shall it be established for ever?
Whom has God been wroth with?
What did God profane by casting it to the ground?
What has God broken down?
Who spoil him as they pass by the way?
To whom is he a reproach?
Whose right hand has God set up?
What has God turned of David's sword?
What has God cast down to the ground?
What has God shortened?
With what has God covered him?
Shall God's wrath burn like what?
What does the psalmist ask God to remember?
Who liveth and shall not see death?
To whom did God swear his former lovingkindnesses?
q.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ പണ്ടത്തെ കൃപകളെക്കുറിച്ചു ആരോടു സത്യം ചെയ്തു?

q.en: Whose reproach does the psalmist bear in his bosom?
q.ta: அவன் தன் மடியில் யாருடைய நிந்தையைச் சுமக்கிறான்?

q.en: Whose footsteps have the enemies reproached?
What is said at the end of the psalm?
What has the LORD been to us in all generations?
In how many generations has the LORD been our dwelling place?
What was not yet formed when God was already God?
From when to when is the LORD God?
What does the LORD say to the children of men?
To God, a thousand years are like what day?
q.ta: தேவனுக்கு ஆயிரம் வருஷம் எந்த நாள்போல இருக்கிறது?
q.ml: ദൈവത്തിനു ആയിരം സംവത്സരം ഏതു ദിവസംപോലെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: A thousand years are like what part of the night to God?
In the morning, men are like what that groweth up?
What does the LORD carry them away with?
When does the grass flourish and when is it cut down?
q.ta: புல் எப்போது முளைத்துப் பூக்கிறது, எப்போது அறுப்புண்கிறது?
q.ml: പുല്ല് എപ്പോൾ തഴെച്ചുവളരുന്നു, എപ്പോൾ അരിഞ്ഞു വാടിപ്പോകുന്നു?

q.en: By what are we consumed and troubled?
What has God set before him in the light of his countenance?
q.ta: தேவன் தம் முகத்தின் வெளிச்சத்தில் எதை நிறுத்தினார்?

q.en: What do we spend our years as?
How many years are the days of our years?
If by reason of strength, how many years may a man live?
What is the strength of our years, even at eighty?
Who knoweth the power of God's anger?
What do we ask God to teach us to number?
Why should we number our days?

a.en: To apply our hearts unto wisdom

q.en: What does Moses ask God to do concerning his servants?
With what do we ask God to satisfy us early?
q.ta: காலையிலே எதினால் எங்களை திருப்தியாக்கும் என்று கேட்கிறோம்?

q.en: When do we ask to be satisfied with God's mercy?
Make us glad according to what days?
q.ta: எந்த நாட்களுக்குத் தக்கதாக எங்களை மகிழ்ச்சியாக்கும் என்று கேட்கிறோம்?

a.en: The days wherein thou hast afflicted us

q.en: What should appear unto God's servants?
What should appear unto the children of God's servants?
What do we ask God to establish upon us?
q.ml: ഞങ്ങളുടെ എന്തിനെ സാദ്ധ്യമാക്കി തരേണമേ എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: Who shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty?

a.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place

q.en: Under whose shadow shall he abide who dwells in the secret place of the most High?
q.ml: അത്യുന്നതന്റെ മറവിൽ വസിക്കുന്നവൻ ആരുടെ നിഴലിൻ കീഴിൽ പാർക്കും?

q.en: What does the psalmist say the LORD is to him?
From what snare shall he deliver thee?
q.ml: യഹോവ നിന്നെ ഏതു കണിയിൽ നിന്നു വിടുവിക്കും?

q.en: From what pestilence shall he deliver thee?
With what shall he cover thee?
What shall his truth be unto thee?
What shall thou not be afraid of by night?
What shall thou not be afraid of by day?
What walketh in darkness that thou shalt not fear?
When does the destruction waste that thou shalt not fear?
How many shall fall at thy side?
How many shall fall at thy right hand?
With what shalt thou behold the reward of the wicked?
Whom hast thou made thy habitation?
What shall not come nigh thy dwelling?
Who shall God give charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways?
q.ta: உன் வழிகளிலெல்லாம் உன்னைக் காக்கும்படி கர்த்தர் யாருக்குக் கட்டளையிடுவார்?
q.ml: നിന്റെ എല്ലാവഴികളിലും നിന്നെ കാക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു ദൈവം ആരോടു കല്പിക്കും?

q.en: Why will the angels bear thee up in their hands?
q.ta: தூதர்கள் ஏன் உன்னைத் தங்கள் கைகளில் ஏந்திக்கொண்டுபோவார்கள்?

a.en: Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone

q.en: Which two animals shalt thou tread upon?
Which creatures shalt thou trample under feet?

a.en: The young lion and the dragon

q.en: Why will God deliver the one who loves him?

a.en: He hath set his love upon me

q.en: Why will God set him on high?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் ஏன் அவனை உயர்ந்த அடைக்கலத்திலே வைப்பார்?

q.en: What will God do when he calls upon me?
When will God be with him?
With what will God satisfy him?
What will God shew him?
What is a good thing to do unto the LORD?
What is good to sing praises unto?
What is good to shew forth in the morning?
What is good to shew forth every night?
Upon an instrument of how many strings do we praise God?
What has made the psalmist glad?
In what will the psalmist triumph?
How deep are the LORD's thoughts?
Who knoweth not the works of the LORD?
Who doth not understand this?
The wicked spring up like what?
What shall happen to the wicked for ever?
How long is the LORD most high?
What shall perish?
What shall happen to all the workers of iniquity?
Like the horn of what animal will the psalmist's horn be exalted?
q.ta: எந்த மிருகத்தின் கொம்பைப்போல என் கொம்பு உயர்த்தப்படும்?
q.ml: ഏതു മൃഗത്തിന്റെ കൊമ്പുപോലെ എന്റെ കൊമ്പു ഉയരും?

q.en: With what shall the psalmist be anointed?
Like what tree shall the righteous flourish?
Like what tree in Lebanon shall the righteous grow?
Where are those planted who shall flourish?

a.en: In the house of the LORD

q.en: Where shall those planted in the LORD's house flourish?

a.en: In the courts of our God

q.en: When shall the righteous still bring forth fruit?
What is not in the LORD?
Who reigneth and is clothed with majesty?
With what is the LORD clothed and girded?
What is stablished so that it cannot be moved?
What is established of old?
From when is the LORD?
What have lifted up their voice?
Who is mightier than the noise of many waters?
What are very sure?
What becometh the house of the LORD for ever?
To whom does vengeance belong?
Whom does the psalmist call to lift up himself?
To whom should God render a reward?
Who triumph, according to the psalmist's question, "How long"?
Who boast themselves and speak hard things?
What do the wicked break in pieces?
What do the wicked afflict?
Whom do the wicked slay?
What do the wicked say about the God of Jacob?
q.ta: யாக்கோபின் தேவனைக் குறித்து அவர்கள் என்ன சொல்லுகிறார்கள்?

q.en: Whom does the psalmist ask when they will be wise?
q.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്കു എപ്പോൾ ബുദ്ധിവരും എന്നു ആരോടു ചോദിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What did the LORD plant that shall hear?
What did God form that shall see?
Whom doth the LORD chastise?
What does the LORD know about the thoughts of man?
q.ta: மனுஷனுடைய யோசனைகளைக் குறித்து கர்த்தர் என்ன அறிந்திருக்கிறார்?

q.en: Who is blessed, according to the psalm?
Until when will God give the righteous rest from the days of adversity?

a.en: Until the pit be digged for the wicked

q.en: Whom will the LORD not cast off?
What will the LORD not forsake?
Judgment shall return unto what?
Who shall follow righteous judgment?
What would have happened to the psalmist's soul unless the LORD had been his help?

a.en: It had almost dwelt in silence

q.en: What held up the psalmist when his foot slipped?
What delight the psalmist's soul in the multitude of his thoughts?
Against whose soul do the wicked gather together?
Whose blood do the wicked condemn?
What kind of rock is God to the psalmist?
What will the LORD bring upon the wicked?
To whom are we told to sing and make a joyful noise?

a.en: The LORD, the rock of our salvation

q.en: What is the LORD called in "the rock of our ..."?
q.ml: യഹോവ നമ്മുടെ എന്തിന്റെ പാറ എന്നു വിളിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു?

q.en: With what should we come before his presence?
With what do we make a joyful noise unto him?
What is the LORD above all gods?
What is in his hand?

a.en: The deep places of the earth

q.en: What of the hills is also his?
What is his, for he made it?
What did his hands form?
What are we to do before the LORD our maker?
q.ta: நம்மை உண்டாக்கின கர்த்தருக்கு முன்பாக என்ன செய்யவேண்டும்?
q.ml: നമ്മെ നിർമ്മിച്ച യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പിൽ എന്തു ചെയ്യേണം?

q.en: What are we, the people of his pasture?
What are we told not to harden?
Where was the day of temptation?
Who tempted and proved God in the wilderness?
How many years was God grieved with that generation?
q.ta: எத்தனை வருஷம் தேவன் அந்தச் சந்ததியை அரோசித்தார்?
q.ml: എത്ര ആണ്ടു ദൈവത്തിന്നു ആ തലമുറയോടു നീരസം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു?

q.en: What did God say of that people's heart?
q.ta: அந்த ஜனத்தின் இருதயத்தைப் பற்றி தேவன் என்ன சொன்னார்?
q.ml: ആ ജനത്തിന്റെ ഹൃദയത്തെക്കുറിച്ചു ദൈവം എന്തു പറഞ്ഞു?

a.en: They do err in their heart

q.en: Into what did God swear they should not enter?
In what did God swear they should not enter his rest?
What kind of song are we to sing unto the LORD?
Who are called to sing unto the LORD?
What are we to shew forth from day to day?
What are we to declare among the heathen?
What are we to declare among all people?
To be feared above whom is the LORD?
What are all the gods of the nations?
What did the LORD make?
What are before him?
What are in his sanctuary?
Who are told to give glory and strength to the LORD?
q.ta: கர்த்தருக்கு மகிமையையும் வல்லமையையும் செலுத்த சொல்லப்படுகிறவர்கள் யார்?
q.ml: യഹോവെക്കു മഹത്വവും ബലവും കൊടുക്കാൻ ആരോടു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: What are we to bring when we come into his courts?
q.ta: அவருடைய பிராகாரங்களில் பிரவேசிக்கும்போது எதைக் கொண்டுவர வேண்டும்?

q.en: In what are we to worship the LORD?
What are we to say among the heathen?
How shall he judge the people?
What shall roar, and the fulness thereof?
What shall rejoice and be glad?
What shall rejoice then, all the trees of where?
Why is the LORD coming?
How shall he judge the world?
Who reigneth, so that the earth should rejoice?
Who are to be glad besides the earth?
What are round about him?
What is the habitation of his throne?
What goeth before him?
Whom does the fire burn up round about?
What enlightened the world?
What did the earth do when it saw his lightnings?
What melted like wax at the presence of the LORD?
The hills melted like what?
What declare his righteousness?
What do all the people see?
Who shall be confounded?
Who heard and was glad?
Who rejoiced because of the LORD's judgments?
Above what is the LORD high?
Above whom is the LORD exalted far?
What are those who love the LORD told to hate?
What does the LORD preserve?
What is sown for the righteous?
What is sown for the upright in heart?
In whom are the righteous told to rejoice?
Why are we to sing a new song unto the LORD?
What hath gotten the LORD the victory?

a.en: His right hand and holy arm

q.en: What hath the LORD made known?
Where hath the LORD openly shewed his righteousness?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் தமது நீதியை யாருடைய கண்களுக்கு முன்பாக விளங்கப்பண்ணினார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ നീതിയെ ആരുടെ മുമ്പിൽ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തി?

a.en: In the sight of the heathen

q.en: Toward which house hath he remembered his mercy and truth?
q.ml: ഏതു ഗൃഹത്തിന്നു തന്റെ ദയയും വിശ്വസ്തതയും ഓർത്തിരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Who have seen the salvation of our God?

a.en: All the ends of the earth

q.en: Who are told to make a joyful noise unto the LORD?
With what instrument are we to sing unto the LORD?
With what do we make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King?
q.ta: கர்த்தராகிய ராஜாவின் முன் எவற்றால் ஆர்ப்பரிக்க வேண்டும்?

q.en: What shall clap their hands?
What shall be joyful together before the LORD?
Why doth the LORD come?
With what shall he judge the people?
Between what does the LORD sit?
In which place is the LORD great?
What are they to praise, for it is holy?
In which place doth God execute judgment and righteousness?
Where are we to worship the LORD our God?
Why are we to exalt the LORD and worship at his footstool?
q.ta: நாம் ஏன் கர்த்தரை உயர்த்திப் பணிய வேண்டும்?

q.en: Who were among his priests?
Who was among them that call upon his name?
Where did God speak unto them?
What kind of God wast thou to them?
On what mount are we to worship the LORD our God?
With what are we to serve the LORD?
With what are we to come before his presence?
Who is God, that we are to know?
Who hath made us?
What are we, of his pasture?
With what do we enter into his gates?
With what do we enter into his courts?
How is the LORD?
How long is his mercy?
To how many generations doth his truth endure?
Of what will the psalmist sing?
How will the psalmist behave himself?
Where will he walk with a perfect heart?
What will he not set before his eyes?
Whose work does he hate?
What shall depart from the psalmist?
Whom will the psalmist cut off?
Whom will he not suffer?

a.en: An high look and a proud heart

q.en: Upon whom shall his eyes be?
Who shall serve him?

a.en: He that walketh in a perfect way

q.en: Who shall not dwell within his house?
Who shall not tarry in his sight?
When will the psalmist destroy all the wicked of the land?
From which city will he cut off all wicked doers?
To whom does the psalmist pray, asking Him to hear his prayer?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தன் விண்ணப்பத்தைக் கேட்கும்படி யாரை நோக்கி வேண்டுகிறான்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ തന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേൾക്കേണമേ എന്നു ആരോടു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What does the psalmist ask to come unto the LORD?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தன்னுடைய எது கர்த்தரிடத்தில் சேர வேண்டும் என்கிறான்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ തന്റെ എന്തു യഹോവയുടെ സന്നിധിയിൽ വരണമെന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: In which day does the psalmist ask God not to hide His face?
q.ta: எந்த நாளில் தம் முகத்தை மறையாதிருக்கும்படி சங்கீதக்காரன் வேண்டுகிறான்?
q.ml: ഏതു ദിവസത്തിൽ തന്റെ മുഖം മറെക്കരുതേ എന്നു സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What does the psalmist ask God to incline unto him?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தன்னிடத்தில் எதைச் சாய்க்கும்படி தேவனிடம் வேண்டுகிறான்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ തന്നിലേക്കു എന്തു ചായിക്കേണമേ എന്നു ദൈവത്തോടു അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What are the psalmist's days consumed like?
What are the psalmist's bones burned like?
What is the psalmist's heart withered like?
What does the psalmist forget to do because of his sorrow?
By reason of what do the psalmist's bones cleave to his skin?
q.ml: എന്തിന്റെ ഒച്ചനിമിത്തം സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരന്റെ അസ്ഥികൾ മാംസത്തോടു പറ്റുന്നു?

q.en: Which bird of the wilderness does the psalmist say he is like?
q.ta: வனாந்தரத்தில் எந்தப் பறவைக்குத் தான் ஒப்பானேன் என்று சங்கீதக்காரன் சொல்கிறான்?
q.ml: മരുഭൂമിയിലെ ഏതു പക്ഷിയെപ്പോലെ ആകുന്നു എന്നു സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ പറയുന്നു?

q.en: Which bird of the desert does the psalmist say he is like?
q.ta: பாழான இடங்களில் தங்கும் எந்தப் பறவையைப்போலானேன் என்கிறான்?
q.ml: ശൂന്യസ്ഥലത്തെ ഏതു പക്ഷിയെപ്പോലെ ആകുന്നു എന്നു അവൻ പറയുന്നു?

q.en: Where is the sparrow that the psalmist compares himself to?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தன்னை ஒப்பிடும் குருவி எங்கே இருக்கிறது?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ തന്നെ ഉപമിക്കുന്ന കുരികിൽ എവിടെ ഇരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Who reproach the psalmist all the day?
What has the psalmist eaten like bread?
What does the psalmist mingle with his drink?
Because of what does the psalmist suffer, having been lifted up and cast down?
q.ta: உயரத்தூக்கி தாழத்தள்ளப்பட்ட சங்கீதக்காரன் எதன் நிமித்தம் துன்புறுகிறான்?

q.en: What are the psalmist's days like?
How long shall the LORD endure?
Unto how many generations does the LORD's remembrance last?
Upon which place will the LORD arise and have mercy?
q.ml: യഹോവ എഴുന്നേറ്റു ഏതു സ്ഥലത്തോടു കരുണ കാണിക്കും?

q.en: In what do God's servants take pleasure concerning Zion?
q.ta: சீயோனில் தேவனுடைய ஊழியக்காரர் எதன்மேல் வாஞ்சை வைக்கிறார்கள்?
q.ml: സീയോനിൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ ദാസന്മാർക്കു എന്തിനോടു താല്പര്യം തോന്നുന്നു?

q.en: Whom will the LORD build up and appear in His glory?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் யாரைக் கட்டி தமது மகிமையில் வெளிப்படுவார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ ആരെ പണിതു തന്റെ മഹത്വത്തിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷനാകും?

q.en: Whose name and glory shall the heathen and kings of the earth fear?
q.ta: ஜாதிகளும் பூமியின் ராஜாக்களும் யாருடைய நாமத்துக்கும் மகிமைக்கும் பயப்படுவார்கள்?
q.ml: ജാതികളും ഭൂമിയിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാരും ആരുടെ നാമത്തെയും മഹത്വത്തെയും ഭയപ്പെടും?

q.en: Whose prayer will the LORD regard and not despise?
For whom shall this be written?
Whom shall the people which shall be created praise?
From where did the LORD look down to behold the earth?

a.en: From the height of his sanctuary

q.en: Whose groaning does the LORD hear?
Where shall the name of the LORD be declared?
Where shall the LORD's praise be declared?
What did God weaken in the way?
What did God shorten?
What did the psalmist ask God not to take away in the midst of his days?
q.ta: பாதி வயதில் தேவன் எதை எடுத்துக்கொள்ளாதிருக்க சங்கீதக்காரன் வேண்டினான்?
q.ml: ആയുസ്സിന്റെ മദ്ധ്യത്തിൽ ദൈവം എന്തു എടുത്തുകളയരുതേ എന്നു അവൻ പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Throughout how many generations are God's years?
What did God lay the foundation of in the beginning?
What are the heavens?
What shall wax old like a garment, while God endures?
What shall have no end?
Who shall continue and be established before God?
Whom does the psalmist call to bless the LORD?
Whose name should the soul bless?
What should the soul not forget?
What does the LORD forgive?
What does the LORD heal?
From what does the LORD redeem thy life?
With what does the LORD crown thee?
With what does the LORD satisfy thy mouth?
Whose youth is thy youth renewed like?
For whom does the LORD execute righteousness and judgment?
q.ml: യഹോവ ആർക്കു വേണ്ടി നീതിയും ന്യായവും നടത്തുന്നു?

q.en: To whom did the LORD make known his ways?
To whom did the LORD make known his acts?
How is the LORD described, slow to anger?
What will the LORD not do always?
According to what has the LORD not dealt with us?
How high is the heaven above the earth, to which his mercy toward them that fear him is compared?
q.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ദയ ഭക്തന്മാരോടു എത്ര വലുതാണെന്നു ഉപമിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു?

a.en: As high as the heaven above the earth

q.en: How far has the LORD removed our transgressions from us?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் நம்முடைய பாவங்களை எவ்வளவு தூரம் விலக்கினார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ നമ്മുടെ ലംഘനങ്ങളെ എത്ര ദൂരം അകറ്റിയിരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Whom does a father pity, as the LORD pities them that fear him?
q.ta: தகப்பன் யாருக்கு இரங்குகிறதுபோல கர்த்தர் தமக்குப் பயந்தவர்களுக்கு இரங்குகிறார்?
q.ml: അപ്പന്നു ആരോടു കരുണ തോന്നുന്നതുപോലെ യഹോവെക്കു ഭക്തന്മാരോടു കരുണ തോന്നുന്നു?

q.en: What does the LORD remember that we are?
What are man's days like?
As what does man flourish?
What passes over the flower so that it is gone?
q.ta: புஷ்பத்தின்மேல் வீசினவுடனே அது இல்லாமற்போகச் செய்வது எது?

q.en: Upon whom is the mercy of the LORD from everlasting to everlasting?
Unto whom is his righteousness?
To whom does his mercy belong, among those who remember his commandments?
Where has the LORD prepared his throne?
Over what does his kingdom rule?
Whom does the psalmist call to bless the LORD, that excel in strength?
Who else is called to bless the LORD, ministers that do his pleasure?
q.ta: கர்த்தருடைய பிரியமானதைச் செய்கிற யாரை ஸ்தோத்திரிக்க அழைக்கிறான்?
q.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ഇഷ്ടം ചെയ്യുന്ന ശുശ്രൂഷക്കാരായ ആരെ വാഴ്ത്തുവാൻ വിളിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Whom does the psalmist call to bless the LORD in all places of his dominion?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் ஆளுகிற எவ்விடங்களிலுமுள்ள யாரை ஸ்தோத்திரிக்கச் சொல்கிறான்?
q.ml: യഹോവയുടെ ആധിപത്യത്തിലെ സകലസ്ഥലങ്ങളിലുമുള്ള ആരെ വാഴ്ത്തുവാൻ പറയുന്നു?

q.en: With what is the LORD clothed?
With what does the LORD cover himself as with a garment?
What does the LORD stretch out like a curtain?
What does the LORD make his chariot?
Upon what does the LORD walk?
Whom does the LORD make spirits?
What does the LORD make his ministers?
What did the LORD lay the foundations of, that it should not be removed for ever?
With what did the LORD cover the earth as with a garment?
Above what did the waters stand?
At what did the waters flee?
What has the LORD set for the waters so that they do not cover the earth again?
q.ta: தண்ணீர்கள் பூமியை மூடிக்கொள்ளாதபடி கர்த்தர் எதை ஏற்படுத்தினார்?
q.ml: വെള്ളം ഭൂമിയെ മൂടാതിരിക്കേണ്ടതിന്നു യഹോവ എന്തു ഇട്ടു?

q.en: Where does the LORD send the springs?
Which animals quench their thirst at the springs?
Who have their habitation by the springs and sing among the branches?
From where does the LORD water the hills?
What does the LORD cause to grow for the cattle?
What makes glad the heart of man?
What makes man's face to shine?
What strengtheneth man's heart?
Which cedars did the LORD plant?
What is the house of the stork?
For which animals are the high hills a refuge?
For which animals are the rocks a refuge?
What did the LORD appoint for seasons?
What knoweth its going down?
What do the beasts of the forest do when the LORD makes darkness and it is night?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் இருளைக் கட்டளையிடும் இராக்காலத்தில் காட்டு ஜீவன்கள் என்ன செய்யும்?
q.ml: യഹോവ ഇരുട്ടു വരുത്തി രാത്രി ആകുമ്പോൾ കാട്ടുമൃഗങ്ങൾ എന്തു ചെയ്യുന്നു?

q.en: Which animals roar after their prey?
From whom do the young lions seek their meat?
When do the beasts lay down in their dens?
Until when does man labour at his work?
In what has the LORD made all his works?
q.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ ഒക്കെയും എങ്ങനെ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയിരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What is great and wide, with innumerable creeping things?
q.ta: அநேக ஜீவன்கள் சஞ்சரிக்கும் பெரிதும் விஸ்தாரமுமானது எது?

q.en: What go in the sea?
What is the creature God made to play in the sea?
Upon whom do all creatures wait to be given their meat in due season?
q.ta: ஏற்றவேளையில் ஆகாரம் பெற எல்லாம் யாரை நோக்கிக் காத்திருக்கும்?
q.ml: തക്കസമയത്തു തീൻ കിട്ടേണ്ടതിന്നു ഇവ ഒക്കെയും ആരെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: What does God open so that they are filled with good?
q.ta: தேவன் எதைத் திறக்க அவைகள் நன்மையால் திருப்தியாகும்?
q.ml: ദൈവം എന്തു തുറക്കുമ്പോൾ അവെക്കു നന്മകൊണ്ടു തൃപ്തിവരുന്നു?

q.en: What does God take away so that creatures die?
q.ta: அவைகள் மாண்டு போகும்படி தேவன் எதை வாங்கிக்கொள்கிறார்?

q.en: To what do the creatures return when they die?
What does the LORD send forth so that creatures are created?
What does the LORD renew?
How long shall the glory of the LORD endure?
What happens to the earth when the LORD looks on it?
What happens when the LORD touches the hills?
How long will the psalmist sing unto the LORD?
What shall be sweet to the psalmist?
Who shall be consumed out of the earth?
Unto whom should we give thanks?
Among whom should we make known the LORD's deeds?
Of what should we talk?
In what should we glory?
Whose heart should rejoice?
Whom and what else should we seek?
Whose seed are those addressed in this psalm?
Whose children are those addressed, his chosen?
For how many generations did God command his word?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் தமது வாக்கை எத்தனை தலைமுறைக்குக் கட்டளையிட்டார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ തന്റെ വചനത്തെ എത്ര തലമുറയോളം കല്പിച്ചു?

q.en: With whom did the LORD make his covenant?
Unto whom did the LORD swear his oath?
To whom did the LORD confirm the covenant for a law?
To whom was it an everlasting covenant?
Which land did the LORD promise to give as the lot of their inheritance?
q.ta: சுதந்தரபாகமாக கர்த்தர் எந்த தேசத்தைத் தருவேன் என்றார்?
q.ml: അവകാശത്തിന്റെ ഓഹരിയായി യഹോവ ഏതു ദേശം തരുമെന്നു അരുളിച്ചെയ്തു?

q.en: What were they in the land when they were few in number?
q.ta: கொஞ்சத் தொகையாயிருந்த அவர்கள் அங்கே எப்படி இருந்தார்கள்?
q.ml: എണ്ണത്തിൽ കുറഞ്ഞ അവർ അവിടെ എങ്ങനെയുള്ളവർ ആയിരുന്നു?

q.en: Whom did the LORD reprove for their sakes?
Whom did the LORD say not to touch?
Whom did the LORD say to do no harm?
q.ml: യഹോവ ആർക്കു ദോഷം ചെയ്യരുതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What did the LORD call for upon the land?
Whom did the LORD send before them?
What was Joseph sold as?
With what did they bind Joseph's feet?
What tried Joseph until his word came?
Who sent and loosed Joseph?
Of what did the king make Joseph lord?
What did Joseph teach the king's senators?
Who came into Egypt?
In which land did Jacob sojourn?
What did God do to his people greatly?
q.ta: தேவன் தம்முடைய ஜனங்களை மிகவும் என்ன செய்தார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ ജനത്തെ ഏറ്റവും എന്തു ചെയ്തു?

q.en: What did God turn to hate his people?
q.ml: തന്റെ ജനത്തെ പകെപ്പാൻ അവൻ എന്തു മറിച്ചുകളഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Whom did the LORD send as his servant?
Whom had the LORD chosen and sent with Moses?
In whose land did they shew his wonders?
What did the LORD send and make dark?
Into what did the LORD turn their waters?
What did the LORD slay when the waters turned to blood?
What did their land bring forth in abundance, even in the chambers of their kings?
q.ml: അവരുടെ ദേശത്തു വ്യാപിച്ചു രാജാക്കന്മാരുടെ പള്ളിയറകളിൽ നിറഞ്ഞതു എന്ത്?

q.en: What came in all their coasts besides divers sorts of flies?
What did He give them for rain?
Which trees, besides the vines, did the LORD smite?
What came at his word, and caterpillers without number?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் கட்டளையிட எண்ணிமுடியாத பச்சைப்புழுக்களோடு வந்தது எது?

q.en: Whom did the LORD smite in their land, the chief of all their strength?
With what did the LORD bring them forth?
Who was glad when they departed?
What did the LORD spread for a covering?
What did the LORD give to light the night?
What did He bring when the people asked?
What did He open so that waters gushed out?
q.ml: വെള്ളം ചാടി പുറപ്പെടേണ്ടതിന്നു അവൻ എന്തിനെ പിളർന്നു?

q.en: Whom did He remember with his holy promise?
With what did He bring forth his people?
What did He give them that they might observe his statutes?
Why did He give them the lands?

a.en: To keep his statutes and laws

q.en: What should we do to the LORD, for he is good?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் நல்லவர் என்பதால் அவரை என்ன செய்யவேண்டும்?

q.en: How long does the LORD's mercy endure?
Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD?
Who are blessed, according to the psalmist?
When should a blessed man do righteousness?
What did the psalmist ask the LORD to visit him with?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் எதினால் தன்னைச் சந்திக்கும்படி கர்த்தரிடம் கேட்டான்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ എന്തുകൊണ്ടു തന്നെ സന്ദർശിക്കേണമെന്നു യഹോവയോടു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: In whose gladness did the psalmist want to rejoice?
With whom have we sinned, according to the psalm?
In which land did the fathers not understand God's wonders?
q.ta: பிதாக்கள் எந்த தேசத்தில் தேவனுடைய அதிசயங்களை உணரவில்லை?
q.ml: പിതാക്കന്മാർ ഏതു ദേശത്തുവെച്ചു ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അത്ഭുതങ്ങളെ ഗ്രഹിച്ചില്ല?

q.en: Where did the fathers provoke God?
Why did God save Israel at the Red sea?
What did God rebuke so that it was dried up?
From whose hand did God redeem them?
q.ta: தேவன் யாருடைய கைக்கு அவர்களை விலக்கி மீட்டார்?

q.en: What covered their enemies at the sea?
How many of their enemies were left?
What did they do when they believed his words?
q.ta: அவருடைய வார்த்தைகளை விசுவாசித்தபோது அவர்கள் என்ன செய்தார்கள்?
q.ml: അവന്റെ വചനങ്ങളെ വിശ്വസിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ എന്തു ചെയ്തു?

q.en: How soon did Israel forget God's works?
q.ta: இஸ்ரவேலர் தேவனுடைய கிரியைகளை எவ்வளவு சீக்கிரம் மறந்தார்கள்?
q.ml: യിസ്രായേൽ ദൈവത്തിന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളെ എത്ര വേഗം മറന്നു?

q.en: Where did they lust exceedingly and tempt God?
q.ml: അവർ എവിടെവെച്ചു ഏറ്റവും മോഹിച്ചു ദൈവത്തെ പരീക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: What did God send into their soul after giving their request?
q.ta: கேட்டதைக் கொடுத்தபின் தேவன் அவர்கள் ஆத்துமாக்களில் எதை அனுப்பினார்?
q.ml: അപേക്ഷിച്ചതു കൊടുത്തശേഷം ദൈവം അവരുടെ പ്രാണന്നു എന്തു അയച്ചു?

q.en: Whom did they envy in the camp besides Moses?
What was Aaron called in the psalm?
Whom did the earth open and swallow up?
Whose company did the earth cover?
What burned up the wicked in their company?
Where did they make a calf?
What did they worship in Horeb?
Into the likeness of what did they change their glory?
In which land had God done great things that they forgot?
q.ta: தேவன் பெரிய கிரியைகளைச் செய்த எந்த தேசத்தை அவர்கள் மறந்தார்கள்?
q.ml: ദൈവം വലിയ കാര്യങ്ങൾ ചെയ്ത ഏതു ദേശത്തെ അവർ മറന്നു?

q.en: In which land did God do wondrous works?
Who stood before God in the breach to turn away his wrath?
q.ta: தேவனுடைய உக்கிரத்தை ஆற்ற திறப்பின் வாயிலே நின்றவன் யார்?
q.ml: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ കോപത്തെ ശമിപ്പിപ്പാൻ പിളർപ്പിൽ നിന്നവൻ ആര്?

q.en: What did God say he would do to them?
What did they despise?
Where did they murmur?
Where did God lift up his hand to overthrow them?
q.ta: தேவன் அவர்களை மடியப்பண்ண எங்கே தம் கையை எடுத்தார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം അവരെ വീഴിക്കുമെന്നു എവിടെ കൈ ഉയർത്തി?

q.en: Which false god did they join themselves unto?
Sacrifices of whom did they eat?
What broke in upon them when they provoked God?
q.ta: அவர்கள் கோபம் மூட்டினபோது அவர்களுக்குள் எது புகுந்தது?

q.en: Who stood up and executed judgment so the plague was stayed?
q.ta: எழுந்து நின்று நியாயஞ்செய்து வாதையை நிறுத்தினவன் யார்?
q.ml: എഴുന്നേറ്റു ശിക്ഷ നടത്തി ബാധ നിർത്തിയവൻ ആര്?

q.en: What was counted unto Phinehas for all generations?
At which waters did they anger God so that it went ill with Moses?
q.ta: எந்த தண்ணீர்களிடத்தில் அவர்கள் கோபம் மூட்டினதால் மோசேக்கும் பொல்லாப்பு நடந்தது?
q.ml: ഏതു വെള്ളത്തിങ്കൽ അവർ കോപിപ്പിച്ചതിനാൽ മോശെക്കും ദോഷം ഭവിച്ചു?

q.en: What did Moses do because they provoked his spirit?
q.ta: அவர்கள் அவன் ஆவியை விசனப்படுத்தியதால் மோசே என்ன செய்தான்?
q.ml: അവർ അവന്റെ മനസ്സിനെ കോപിപ്പിച്ചതുകൊണ്ടു മോശെ എന്തു ചെയ്തു?

q.en: Whom did they fail to destroy as the LORD commanded?
What became a snare unto them?
Unto whom did they sacrifice their sons and daughters?
q.ta: அவர்கள் தங்கள் குமாரரையும் குமாரத்திகளையும் யாருக்குப் பலியிட்டார்கள்?
q.ml: അവർ തങ്ങളുടെ പുത്രന്മാരെയും പുത്രിമാരെയും ആർക്കു ബലികഴിച്ചു?

q.en: What polluted the land?
To the idols of which land did they sacrifice their children?
What did the LORD abhor when his wrath was kindled?
q.ta: கர்த்தருடைய கோபம் மூண்டபோது அவர் எதை அருவருத்தார்?
q.ml: യഹോവയുടെ കോപം ജ്വലിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവൻ എന്തിനെ വെറുത്തു?

q.en: Into whose hand did God give his people?
q.ta: தேவன் தம் ஜனத்தை யாருடைய கையில் ஒப்புக்கொடுத்தார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ ജനത്തെ ആരുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഏല്പിച്ചു?

q.en: What did God regard when he heard their cry?
q.ta: அவர்கள் கூப்பிடுதலைக் கேட்டபோது தேவன் எதை நோக்கினார்?
q.ml: അവരുടെ നിലവിളി കേട്ടപ്പോൾ ദൈവം എന്തിനെ കടാക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: What did God remember for them?
Who were made to pity Israel?
From among whom did the psalmist ask God to gather them?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ആരുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു ശേഖരിക്കേണമേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: What should all the people say?
Why should we give thanks to the LORD?
From whose hand has the LORD redeemed his people?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் யாருடைய கையிலிருந்து தம் ஜனத்தை மீட்டார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ ആരുടെ കയ്യിൽനിന്നു തന്റെ ജനത്തെ വീണ്ടെടുത്തു?

q.en: From how many directions did God gather the redeemed out of the lands?
Where did they wander in a solitary way?
What did they not find to dwell in?
What fainted in them when they were hungry and thirsty?
q.ta: அவர்கள் பசியாகவும் தாகமாகவும் இருந்தபோது எது தொய்ந்தது?
q.ml: അവർ വിശന്നും ദാഹിച്ചും ഇരുന്നപ്പോൾ ഉള്ളിൽ തളർന്നതു എന്തു?

q.en: What did they do to the LORD in their trouble?
q.ta: தங்கள் ஆபத்திலே அவர்கள் கர்த்தரை என்ன செய்தார்கள்?

q.en: By what way did God lead them to a city of habitation?
Whom does God satisfy, and whom does he fill with goodness?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் யாரைத் திருப்தியாக்குகிறார், யாரை நன்மையினால் நிரப்புகிறார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം ആരെ തൃപ്തിപ്പെടുത്തുകയും ആരെ നന്മകൊണ്ടു നിറെക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു?

a.en: The longing soul and the hungry soul

q.en: In what did those sit who were bound in affliction and iron?

a.en: Darkness and the shadow of death

q.en: Against whose words had they rebelled?
Whose counsel did they contemn?
With what did God bring down their heart?
How many were there to help when they fell down?
q.ta: அவர்கள் விழுந்தபோது சகாயம்செய்ய எத்தனை பேர் இருந்தார்கள்?

q.en: What did God brake in sunder?
What did God break and what did he cut in sunder?

a.en: Gates of brass, bars of iron

q.en: Who are afflicted because of their transgression?
What did their soul abhor?
To what did they draw near?
What did God send to heal them?
What sacrifices should they sacrifice?
In what do they go down to the sea?
Where do seafarers see God's wonders?
q.ta: கடல் யாத்திரைபண்ணுகிறவர்கள் தேவனுடைய அதிசயங்களை எங்கே காண்கிறார்கள்?

q.en: What does God raise at his command that lifts up the waves?
q.ta: தேவன் கட்டளையிட எது எழும்பி அலைகளைக் கொந்தளிக்கப்பண்ணும்?

q.en: What is melted because of trouble?
Like whom do they stagger?
What does God make of the storm so that the waves are still?
Unto what place does God bring them?
q.ta: தேவன் அவர்களை எந்த இடத்தில் கொண்டுவந்து சேர்க்கிறார்?

q.en: Where should they exalt God and praise him?

a.en: In the congregation of the people

q.en: In whose assembly should they praise him?
What does God turn into a wilderness?
Why does God turn a fruitful land into barrenness?

a.en: For the wickedness of those who dwell there

q.en: What does God turn the wilderness into?
Whom does God make to dwell in the wilderness turned into water?
What do they plant that yields fruits of increase?
q.ta: வரத்துள்ள பலனைத் தர அவர்கள் எதை நாட்டுகிறார்கள்?

q.en: What does God not suffer to decrease?
Through what are they minished and brought low?
Upon whom does God pour contempt?
Whom does God set on high from affliction?
To what does God make the families of the poor like?
Who shall see it and rejoice?
Who will understand the lovingkindness of the LORD?
What did the psalmist say about his heart?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தன் இருதயத்தைக் குறித்து என்ன சொன்னான்?

q.en: Which instruments did the psalmist tell to awake?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ഏതു വാദ്യങ്ങളോടു ഉണരുവിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Among whom will the psalmist sing praises to the LORD?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ആരുടെ മദ്ധ്യേ യഹോവക്കു കീർത്തനം പാടും?

q.en: How great is God's mercy?
Unto what does God's truth reach?
Above what should God's glory be exalted?
Why did the psalmist ask God to save with his right hand?

a.en: That thy beloved may be delivered

q.en: Which two lands does God call his, besides Ephraim and Judah?
q.ta: எப்பிராயீம், யூதா தவிர தேவன் எவற்றைத் தம்முடையது என்றார்?
q.ml: എഫ്രയീമും യെഹൂദയും കൂടാതെ ദൈവം ഏവയെ എനിക്കുള്ളതു എന്നു പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: Who is God's lawgiver?
Over which land will God cast out his shoe?
q.ta: தேவன் எந்த தேசத்தின்மேல் தம் பாதரட்சையை எறிவார்?
q.ml: ദൈവം ഏതു ദേശത്തിന്മേൽ തന്റെ ചെരിപ്പു എറിയും?

q.en: Over which land will God triumph?
Into which place did the psalmist ask who would lead him?
q.ta: யாரிடம் வழிகாட்டுவார் என்று சங்கீதக்காரன் கேட்டான், எந்த இடத்துக்கு?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ആർ ഏതു സ്ഥലത്തേക്കു വഴിനടത്തും എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു?

q.en: Who shall tread down our enemies?
Whom did the psalmist call "God of my praise"?
What did the psalmist ask God not to hold?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரன் தேவனிடம் எப்படி இருக்கவேண்டாம் என்று கேட்டான்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ദൈവം എങ്ങനെ ഇരിക്കരുതു എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: What did the wicked speak against the psalmist with?
With what did they compass the psalmist about?
How did they fight against the psalmist?
To what did the psalmist give himself?
What did they reward the psalmist for good?
What did they reward for his love?
q.ta: சங்கீதக்காரனின் சிநேகத்துக்குப் பதிலாக அவர்கள் எதைக் கொடுத்தார்கள்?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരന്റെ സ്നേഹത്തിന്നു പകരം അവർ എന്തു കാണിച്ചു?

q.en: Who shall stand at the right hand of the wicked man?
What should his prayer become?
What should another take?
What should his children be?
What should his wife become?
What should his children do continually?
Who should catch all that he hath?
Who should spoil his labour?
What should be cut off and blotted out in the generation following?
Whose iniquity should be remembered with the LORD?
Whose sin should not be blotted out?
Whom did he persecute instead of showing mercy?
What did he love?
What did he not delight in?
With what did he clothe himself like a garment?
Like what did the cursing come into his bones?
What should the curse be for a girdle?

a.en: A girdle wherewith he is girded continually

q.en: For whose sake did the psalmist ask God to deliver him?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ആരുടെ നാമം നിമിത്തം വിടുവിക്കേണമേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: Why did the psalmist ask God to deliver him?
What did the psalmist say he was?
What was wounded within him?
To what did the psalmist compare himself that declineth?
Like what creature was he tossed up and down?
Why were his knees weak?
What did they do when they looked upon him?
What did he become unto them?
According to what did the psalmist ask God to save him?
q.ml: സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ എന്തിന്നു തക്കവണ്ണം രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ എന്നു അപേക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: What should they know is the LORD's?
What should God do when they curse?
With what should his adversaries be clothed?
With what will the psalmist greatly praise the LORD?
Among whom will he praise the LORD?
Where shall the LORD stand to save the poor?
Where did the LORD tell my Lord to sit?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் என் ஆண்டவரை எங்கே உட்காரச் சொன்னார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ എന്റെ കർത്താവിനോടു എവിടെ ഇരിക്കാൻ പറഞ്ഞു?

q.en: What will God make of the enemies of my Lord?
Out of where shall the LORD send the rod of thy strength?
In the midst of whom shall he rule?
When shall thy people be willing?

a.en: In the day of thy power

q.en: After whose order is the LORD a priest for ever?
What did the LORD do concerning the priesthood, and will not repent?
Whom shall the Lord at thy right hand strike through?
When shall he strike through kings?

a.en: In the day of his wrath

q.en: Among whom shall he judge?
From what shall he drink in the way?
With how much of his heart will the psalmist praise the LORD?
In whose assembly will he praise the LORD?
What are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein?
What endureth for ever?
What is the LORD, full of?
To whom hath the LORD given meat?
What will the LORD ever be mindful of?
What did the LORD give his people?
What are the works of his hands?
How are all his commandments described?
What did God send unto his people?
How is God's name described?
What is the beginning of wisdom?
Who have a good understanding?
Who is the blessed man in Psalm 112?

a.en: The man that feareth the LORD

q.en: In what does the blessed man delight greatly?
What shall be mighty upon earth?
Whose generation shall be blessed?
What shall be in the house of the man who fears the LORD?
What ariseth unto the upright in the darkness?
What does a good man show, and do with money?
How long shall the righteous be in remembrance?
Of what shall the righteous man not be afraid?
In whom is his heart fixed, trusting?
To whom hath he given?
What shall be exalted with honour?
What shall the wicked do with his teeth when he sees it?
Whose servants are called to praise in Psalm 113?
Whose name should the servants of the LORD praise?
What should be blessed from this time forth and for evermore?
From where to where is the LORD's name to be praised?
q.ta: கர்த்தருடைய நாமம் எந்த திசை தொடங்கி எந்த திசைமட்டும் துதிக்கப்படுவதாக?
q.ml: യഹോവയുടെ നാമം എവിടെ മുതൽ എവിടെ വരെ സ്തുതിക്കപ്പെടണം?

q.en: Who is high above all nations?
Above what is the glory of the LORD?
Who is like the LORD our God who dwells on high?
q.ta: உன்னதங்களில் வாசம்பண்ணுகிற நம்முடைய தேவனாகிய கர்த்தருக்குச் சமானமானவர் யார்?
q.ml: ഉന്നതത്തിൽ അധിവസിക്കുന്ന നമ്മുടെ ദൈവമായ യഹോവെക്കു സദൃശൻ ആരുള്ളു?

q.en: What does the LORD humble himself to behold?

a.en: Things in heaven and in the earth

q.en: From where does the LORD raise up the poor?
From where does the LORD lift the needy?
With whom does the LORD set the poor he lifts up?
Whom does the LORD make a joyful mother of children?
q.ml: യഹോവ മക്കളുടെ അമ്മയായി സന്തോഷത്തോടെ വസിക്കുമാറാക്കുന്നത് ആരെ?

q.en: Who went out of Egypt in Psalm 114?
From what kind of people did the house of Jacob go out?
q.ml: യാക്കോബിൻ ഗൃഹം എങ്ങനെയുള്ള ജാതിയുടെ ഇടയിൽനിന്നു പുറപ്പെട്ടു?

q.en: Which tribe became God's sanctuary?
What did Israel become to God?
What saw it and fled?
Which river was driven back?
What did the mountains skip like?
What did the little hills skip like?
Which two does the psalmist ask what ailed them, the sea and which river?
q.ta: கடலே, உனக்கு என்ன வந்தது என்று கேட்கப்பட்டபோது, பின்னிட்டுத் திரும்பியது எந்த நதி?
q.ml: സമുദ്രത്തോടൊപ്പം നീ പിൻവാങ്ങുന്നതെന്തു എന്നു ചോദിച്ചത് ഏത് നദിയോട്?

q.en: What question is asked of the mountains and little hills?
q.ta: மலைகளே, குன்றுகளே, உங்களுக்கு என்ன வந்தது என்று எதற்காகக் கேட்கப்படுகிறது?

a.en: Why they skipped like rams and lambs

q.en: Who is told to tremble at the presence of the Lord?
At the presence of whose God is the earth to tremble?
q.ta: பூமி யாருடைய தேவனுக்கு முன்பாக அதிர வேண்டும்?

q.en: What did the Lord turn into a standing water?
What did the Lord turn into a fountain of waters?
To whom should the glory be given, not unto us?
q.ta: எங்களுக்கு அல்ல, யாருடைய நாமத்திற்கே மகிமை வரப்பண்ண வேண்டும்?

q.en: For whose sake is glory given to the name of the LORD?
q.ta: எவைகளினிமித்தம் கர்த்தருடைய நாமத்திற்கு மகிமை வரப்பண்ண வேண்டும்?

q.en: Who say, Where is now their God?
q.ta: அவர்களுடைய தேவன் இப்பொழுது எங்கே என்று சொல்கிறவர்கள் யார்?
q.ml: അവരുടെ ദൈവം ഇപ്പോൾ എവിടെ എന്നു പറയുന്നത് ആര്?

q.en: Where is our God?
What has our God done?
What are the idols of the heathen made of?
Whose handiwork are the idols?
What do idols have mouths but cannot do?
What do idols have but cannot see with?
What do idols have but cannot hear with?
What do idols have but cannot smell with?
What do idols have hands but cannot do?
What do idols have feet but cannot do?
Who are like the idols?

a.en: Those who make them and trust in them

q.en: Who is told to trust in the LORD in verse 9?
What is the LORD to those who trust in him?
Which house is told to trust in the LORD after Israel?
q.ta: இஸ்ரவேலுக்குப் பின் கர்த்தரை நம்பும்படி சொல்லப்பட்ட குடும்பம் எது?
q.ml: യിസ്രായേലിനു ശേഷം യഹോവയിൽ ആശ്രയിക്കണമെന്നു പറഞ്ഞ ഗൃഹം ഏത്?

q.en: Who else is told to trust in the LORD?
q.ml: യഹോവയിൽ ആശ്രയിപ്പിൻ എന്നു പറഞ്ഞ മറ്റുള്ളവർ ആര്?

q.en: What has the LORD been of us?
Which two houses will the LORD bless?
Whom will the LORD bless, both small and great?
Whom will the LORD increase more and more?
Who blessed you, the LORD who made what?
To whom does the heaven belong?
To whom has the LORD given the earth?
Who do not praise the LORD?
For how long will we bless the LORD?

a.en: From this time forth and for evermore

q.en: Whom does the psalmist love because he heard his voice?
q.ml: തന്റെ പ്രാർത്ഥന കേട്ടതുകൊണ്ടു സങ്കീർത്തനക്കാരൻ ആരെ സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു?

q.en: Why does the psalmist love the LORD?

a.en: He heard my voice and supplications

q.en: What did the LORD incline to the psalmist?
For how long will the psalmist call upon the LORD?
What compassed the psalmist about?
What took hold of the psalmist besides the sorrows of death?
What did the psalmist call upon when in trouble?
What did the psalmist beseech the LORD to deliver?
q.ml: യഹോവേ, എന്തിനെ രക്ഷിക്കേണമേ എന്നു ഞാൻ അപേക്ഷിച്ചു?

q.en: How is the LORD described: gracious and what?
What is our God said to be?
What did the LORD do when the psalmist was brought low?
Where is the soul told to return?
q.ta: ஆத்துமாவே, நீ எதற்குத் திரும்பு என்று சொல்லப்படுகிறது?
q.ml: മനമേ, നീ എങ്ങനെ ഇരിക്ക എന്നു പറയുന്നു?

q.en: From what has the LORD delivered the psalmist's soul?
From what has the LORD delivered the psalmist's eyes?
From what has the LORD delivered the psalmist's feet?
Where will the psalmist walk before the LORD?
q.ta: நான் கர்த்தருக்கு முன்பாக எந்த தேசத்திலே நடப்பேன்?
q.ml: ഞാൻ യഹോവയുടെ മുമ്പാകെ ഏതു ദേശത്തു നടക്കും?

a.en: In the land of the living

q.en: What did the psalmist say in his haste?
What shall I render unto the LORD for what?
q.ml: യഹോവക്കു ഞാൻ എന്തു പകരം കൊടുക്കും, എന്തിനു വേണ്ടി?

q.en: What will the psalmist take?
What will the psalmist pay to the LORD?
In whose presence will the psalmist pay his vows?
What is precious in the sight of the LORD?
Whose son does the psalmist say he is?
What has the LORD loosed?
What sacrifice will the psalmist offer?
Where will the psalmist pay his vows?

a.en: In the courts of the LORD's house

q.en: In the midst of which city will the psalmist pay his vows?
Who are told to praise the LORD in Psalm 117?
What is great toward us?
What endures for ever?
Who is told to say that his mercy endures for ever?
q.ml: അവന്റെ ദയ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു എന്നു പറയേണ്ടത് ആര്?

q.en: Which house is told to say his mercy endures for ever?
q.ml: ദയ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു എന്നു പറയേണ്ട ഗൃഹം ഏത്?

q.en: Who else is told to say his mercy endures for ever?
q.ml: ദയ എന്നേക്കുമുള്ളതു എന്നു പറയേണ്ട മറ്റുള്ളവർ ആര്?

q.en: Where did the LORD set the psalmist when he answered him?
In what condition did the psalmist call upon the LORD?
q.ta: நான் எந்த நிலையில் கர்த்தரை நோக்கிக் கூப்பிட்டேன்?

q.en: Where is the LORD, so that the psalmist will not fear?
What can man do unto me?
Who will the psalmist see his desire upon?
What is better than to trust in man?
Better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in whom?
q.ta: யாரை நம்புவதைப் பார்க்கிலும் கர்த்தரைப் பற்றிக்கொள்வது நலம்?

q.en: Who compassed the psalmist about?
In whose name will the psalmist destroy them?

a.en: In the name of the LORD

q.en: What did the enemies compassed about like?
What are they quenched like?
Who helped the psalmist when he was thrust at to fall?
q.ml: ഞാൻ വീഴുവാൻ തള്ളപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ എന്നെ സഹായിച്ചത് ആര്?

q.en: What is the LORD to the psalmist, besides song and salvation?
q.ta: கர்த்தர் என் கீதமும் இரட்சிப்புமாவதோடு வேறு எதுவானார்?
q.ml: യഹോവ എന്റെ കീർത്തനവും രക്ഷയും ആകുന്നതിനു പുറമെ എന്ത്?

q.en: Where is the voice of rejoicing and salvation?

a.en: In the tabernacles of the righteous

q.en: What is exalted?

a.en: The right hand of the LORD

q.en: To what has the LORD not given the psalmist over?
